metadata.description: Claude Code mods tuned for the Claude desktop app: a live replay of every step Claude takes, and a git dashboard for the repos you watch.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: A live timeline of everything Claude does in a turn (commands, reads, searches, edits) with diffs and output, in a pane.

plugins.name: repo-worktree
plugins.description: Watch the git repos you choose: every worktree and branch, ahead/behind, changed files, and pull, push and sync, refreshed every minute.
